units.source_text: 确实，偶然的一致也不是没有可能的。

en.t: Indeed, a chance coincidence was not entirely impossible.

units.source_text: 然而，这简直就像关在笼子里的人，站在没有配钥匙的大锁之前。

en.t: And yet, it was just like a person shut inside a cage, standing before a large lock for which there was no key.

units.source_text: 就连本地人，都必须习惯忍受幽闭的话，这沙壁的险峻也就不一般了。

en.t: If even the local people had to grow used to enduring confinement, then the steepness of this wall of sand was no ordinary thing.

units.source_text: 男人激动起来，紧紧咬住不放：

en.t: The man grew excited and pressed the point relentlessly:
